---
title: "Writing"
listing:
  - id: featured
    contents: "*.qmd"
    include:
      featured: true
    exclude:
      filename: hello-quarto.qmd
    type: custom
    template: ../_listings/featured.ejs.md
    sort: "featured-order asc"
    max-items: 5
    fields: [title, subtitle, reading-time]
    field-display-names:
      reading-time: ""
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
  - id: all-writing
    contents: "*.qmd"
    exclude:
      filename: "{index,hello-quarto}.qmd"
      featured: true
    type: custom
    template: ../_listings/archive.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, subtitle, date, categories, reading-time]
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
    feed: true
page-layout: full
toc: false
body-classes: writing-index
---
